correctness.rationale: For each omitted a_i, a selected b_j witnesses precisely when U\{j}={i}; symmetric condition for omitted b_i. This proves the finite-size omission iff rule, from which the complete polynomial and minimum family are binomial consequences. For the exchange metric, swaps of a nonzero ground-index color with a zero coincide exactly with legal minimum-set token jumps; the balanced three-color transition graph yields a sharp constructive distance bound, with one buffer move precisely for nonidentical configurations having equal occupied unions. Coefficient extraction plus the five same-union corrections gives the closed shell polynomial. A standalone independent predicate enumerator for n=4..8 and BFS metric verifier for n=4..10 passed VERIFY_OK. No finite test is used to establish infinite quantification.

value.rationale: The polynomial classifies every labeled super-dominating set in a natural perfect-matching-deleted bipartite family, and the optimum reconfiguration graph has a nontrivial sharp connectivity transition, unique antipodal distance-five state, complete distance shells, and a token-sliding immobility contrast. These are exact natural graph invariants, motivated by published superdomination enumeration and reconfiguration models; they are not just a slight numeric bound improvement or parameter substitution.
